title: Custom MATLAB file
text: 通过使用包含自定义 MATLAB 代码的文件更新父模型的活动配置参数；按 {Configure the model for} 指定配置目标；{Configuration function} 指定自定义 MATLAB 脚本、{Invoke build process after configuration} 指定启动构建过程，按实例取值。

params.name: Configure the model for
params.values: 配置目标 Custom (default) | ERT (optimized for fixed-point) | ERT (optimized for floating-point) | GRT (optimized for fixed/floating-point) | GRT (debug for fixed/floating-point)

params.name: Configuration function
params.values: 自定义 MATLAB 脚本 rtwsampleconfig (default)

params.name: Invoke build process after configuration
params.values: 启动构建过程 off (default) | on
